values.name: __principal_id__
values.description: Identity provider subject of the suspected-compromised principal (user, service principal, or workload identity). The trigger input; the hydration adapter assembles __hydrated_signal__ and __principal_context__ for it.

values.name: __signal_id__
values.description: Identifier of the originating identity-protection / sign-in signal (an Azure AD Identity Protection risk event, an Okta ThreatInsight event, or a SOC-raised ticket).

values.name: __hydrated_signal__
values.description: The signal the hydration adapter assembled for __signal_id__: exactly signal_id, source, detected_at (Zulu), principal_id and detections (names from the triage vocabulary; an unknown name fails loud).

values.name: __principal_context__
values.description: What the IdP says about the principal: exactly principal_type (user, service principal or workload identity) and privileged (a real boolean). A privileged principal is contained on one uncleared detection.

values.name: __benign_patterns__
values.description: The operator's benign patterns, each exactly principal_id, kind (planned_travel or sanctioned_automation), valid_from and valid_until (Zulu). They clear impossible travel and nothing else. CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __analyst_verdict__
values.description: An analyst ruling when one exists: confirmed or benign. It decides over the rule, and a disagreement is recorded as an override. Empty when no analyst has ruled (the n8n trigger supplies an empty string for an unset variable).

values.name: __registered_factors__
values.description: The MFA factors the IdP lists for the principal, each exactly factor_id and kind. CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __requested_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the containment directives are requested at; the MFA and session steps stamp it.

values.name: __live_sessions__
values.description: The live sessions, refresh tokens and device grants the tenant adapters returned, each exactly session_ref, tenant_ref and kind. A session in a tenant that was not enumerated fails loud. CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __reachable_tenants__
values.description: The tenants the principal can reach. CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __enumerated_tenants__
values.description: The tenants whose adapters returned a session inventory; the difference from __reachable_tenants__ is reported as the coverage gap. CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __hunt_findings__
values.description: What the hunt queries found, each exactly surface, resource_ref and observed_at (Zulu). A finding on a surface that was not hunted fails loud. CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __hunted_surfaces__
values.description: The hunt surfaces whose queries actually ran. CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __lookback_hours__
values.description: The operator's hunt lookback window, in hours before detection, as a positive integer.

values.name: __iam_items__
values.description: The principal's IAM surface, each exactly item_ref, kind, created_at (Zulu) and change_ref (the authorising change record, or null). CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __compromise_window_start__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the compromise window opens; it closes at detection. An adapter input, because triage sees detection names and the detection time but not when the compromise began; the sign-in history or forensic-timeline adapter that has it supplies it. A start after detection fails loud.

values.name: __compromise_confirmed__
values.description: Whether triage confirmed the compromise; false closes out as a false positive. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __triage_record__.compromise_confirmed. A real boolean: the gate compares it to true, and the string 'false' is truthy in most runtimes.

values.name: __sessions_revoked_count__
values.description: Number of distinct live sessions, refresh tokens and device grants revoked across the enumerated tenants. Feeds the containment KPI. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __session_revocation_directive__.sessions_revoked_count.

values.name: __lateral_findings_count__
values.description: Distinct downstream resources the principal touched inside the hunt window. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __hunt_summary__.lateral_findings_count.

values.name: __triage_record__
values.description: Envelope the triage step emits: the principal type and privilege, the detections and those a benign pattern cleared, compromise_confirmed as a real boolean with its basis, and overridden_by_analyst.

values.name: __mfa_reset_directive__
values.description: Envelope the MFA step emits: the factors before and after, one action per factor, and the re-enrolment requirement; not applicable to principals that cannot hold factors.

values.name: __session_revocation_directive__
values.description: Envelope the session step emits: one revocation per distinct session, the counts by kind, and the tenants that could not be enumerated.

values.name: __hunt_summary__
values.description: Envelope the hunt step emits: the window, the touched resources and their surfaces, findings outside the window, and hunt coverage as hunted and unhunted surfaces.

values.name: __persistence_removal_plan__
values.description: Envelope the persistence step emits: each IAM item removed or kept, with the reason it was kept.

nodes.name: triage identity signal

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.identity_compromise.primitives.triage import triage_identity_signal
__triage_record__ = triage_identity_signal(signal=__hydrated_signal__, principal_context=__principal_context__, benign_patterns=__benign_patterns__, analyst_verdict=__analyst_verdict__)

nodes.notes: Decide whether the hydrated identity signal confirms a compromise, by an explicit rule: a decisive detection (MFA bypass, MFA disabled, AssumeRole misuse), two corroborating detections, or any detection on a privileged principal. Benign patterns (planned travel, sanctioned automation) clear impossible travel and nothing else. An analyst verdict decides when present, and a disagreement is recorded as an override. Produces __triage_record__, from which __compromise_confirmed__ is extracted.

nodes.name: compromise confirmed?
nodes.notes: Branch on __compromise_confirmed__, set by the triage step. on_true: the compromise is confirmed and the playbook resets the principal's MFA factors. on_false: the signal closes as a false positive.

nodes.name: reset MFA factors
nodes.notes: Compose the factor reset for the principal: revoke every registered factor, invalidate app passwords, and require re-enrolment with step-up at the next sign-in, recording the factor list before and after. A service principal or workload identity holds no factors, so the reset is recorded as not applicable. Produces __mfa_reset_directive__.

nodes.name: revoke active sessions

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.identity_compromise.primitives.sessions import compose_session_revocation
__session_revocation_directive__ = compose_session_revocation(triage=__triage_record__, live_sessions=__live_sessions__, reachable_tenants=__reachable_tenants__, enumerated_tenants=__enumerated_tenants__, requested_at=__requested_at__)

nodes.notes: Compose the revocation of every live session, refresh token and persistent device grant the principal holds across the enumerated tenants, and report the reachable tenants that could not be enumerated as a coverage gap. Produces __session_revocation_directive__, from which __sessions_revoked_count__ is extracted for the containment KPI.

nodes.name: lateral-movement hunt

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.identity_compromise.primitives.hunt import summarise_lateral_hunt
__hunt_summary__ = summarise_lateral_hunt(triage=__triage_record__, hunt_findings=__hunt_findings__, hunted_surfaces=__hunted_surfaces__, lookback_hours=__lookback_hours__)

nodes.notes: Summarise the downstream activity attributable to the principal inside the lookback window (STS / AssumeRole chains, cross-tenant access, API-token reuse, OAuth-grant escalation, host logons): the distinct resources touched, findings outside the window, and how much of the hunt surface was actually queried. Produces __hunt_summary__, from which __lateral_findings_count__ is extracted.

nodes.name: IAM audit and persistence removal
nodes.notes: Audit the principal's IAM surface (OAuth consents, third-party app grants, conditional-access exceptions, inbox rules, device registrations, role assignments) and plan the removal of every item created inside the compromise window without an authorising change record; items that predate the window or carry a change record are kept, with the reason. Produces __persistence_removal_plan__.

parameters.content:
## Identity compromise response
`playbook.identity_compromise@v1` · content v1.0.0 · maturity: stable · compiled from a CACAO 2.0 playbook by SecOps-NG

Respond to a detected account compromise (credential theft, MFA bypass, anomalous sign-in, suspicious OAuth grant, or impossible-travel signal). The playbook drives the operator through MFA reset, session revocation across IdP / SaaS, a lateral-movement hunt scoped to the compromised principal's blast radius, and a final IAM audit to remove residual persistence (rogue OAuth grants, app passwords, conditional-access exceptions). CACAO v2 + SecOps-NG content-model extensions;…

**Controls:** 6 control reference(s) in the canonical source, mapped under `content/mappings/`.

**Before you run it**
- Inputs the trigger expects from you: `__principal_id__`, `__signal_id__`, `__hydrated_signal__`, `__principal_context__`, `__benign_patterns__`, `__analyst_verdict__`, `__registered_factors__`, `__requested_at__`, `__live_sessions__`, `__reachable_tenants__`, `__enumerated_tenants__`, `__hunt_findings__`, `__hunted_surfaces__`, `__lookback_hours__`, `__iam_items__`, `__compromise_window_start__`
- Code nodes name the deterministic primitive each step runs; bind them to where your primitives execute, or replace the body:
  - triage identity signal → `content.playbooks.identity_compromise.primitives.triage.triage_identity_signal`
  - reset MFA factors → `content.playbooks.identity_compromise.primitives.mfa.compose_mfa_reset`
  - revoke active sessions → `content.playbooks.identity_compromise.primitives.sessions.compose_session_revocation`
  - lateral-movement hunt → `content.playbooks.identity_compromise.primitives.hunt.summarise_lateral_hunt`
  - IAM audit and persistence removal → `content.playbooks.identity_compromise.primitives.persistence.plan_persistence_removal`
- This file carries no credentials; connectors and secrets are yours to attach.

**Source** https://github.com/secops-ng/secops-ng-framework/tree/main/content/playbooks/identity_compromise
Regenerate with `python -m tools.compile content/playbooks/identity_compromise/playbook.cacao.json --target n8n`; do not hand-edit the compiled file. Apache-2.0.
